name: lumadeos
description: Process and edit the videos in your Lumadeos account: automatic editing, audio leveling, captions, color, privacy blur and vertical reels.

interface.longDescription:
Lumadeos is a cloud video studio for creators, podcasters, educators and teams. This plugin lets you work on the videos in your own Lumadeos account in a conversation.

Share a link to a recording (a direct file link, a signed cloud-storage link, or a Dropbox or Google Drive file shared with anyone who has the link) and Lumadeos processes it: removes long pauses and filler words, levels the voice to a loudness target, makes .srt/.vtt captions and publishing texts (titles, description, chapters, tags), and checks the result against YouTube advertiser-friendly guidelines.

Then keep editing by asking: cut or mute a range, bring back removed fragments, apply a color preset or allowlisted FFmpeg filters, burn in captions or import your own SRT/VTT, find private information on screen (emails, card numbers, phone numbers, faces) and blur it, rewrite titles, and cut vertical 9:16 reels with captions from the strongest moments. Every edit renders a new version, so you can switch back. Download links for the video, captions, audio and cover frames are valid for 24 hours.

Who it is for: people who record talking-head videos, interviews, podcasts, lectures and screen recordings and want them ready to publish.

Limitations: it works only with videos in the Lumadeos account you sign in with. It does not generate images, video, music or voices with AI models; covers are frames from your own video. Long recordings take several minutes to process, and the plugin reports progress while they run.
capabilities: Process a video from a link: cuts, audio leveling, captions and publishing texts
Edit a finished video: cut, mute, restore fragments, color, filters
Burn in captions or import SRT/VTT subtitles
Find and blur private information on screen
Get download links and switch between versions
defaultPrompt: List my latest videos and tell me which ones are ready.
Cut vertical reels with captions from my latest video.
Find and blur emails and card numbers in my screen recording.

positive.description: List the account's videos with their processing status.
positive.prompt: List my latest Lumadeos videos and tell me which ones are finished.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sample videos in the review account, newest first, with title, status and duration, and says which ones are completed.

positive.description: Return download links for a finished video.
positive.prompt: Give me download links for the final video and the captions of my most recent finished video.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest completed video and returns working links to final.mp4 and the .srt/.vtt captions, noting that the links expire in 24 hours.

positive.description: Cut vertical reels from a finished video.
positive.prompt: Cut vertical reels with burned-in captions from my most recent finished video.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts reel cutting for that video, checks progress, and returns one or more 9:16 reels with a title, hook, duration and mp4 link. If the video has fewer standalone moments than requested, it says how many it could make and why.

positive.description: Find and blur private information in a screen recording.
positive.prompt: Scan my screen recording for private information like emails or card numbers and blur what you find.
positive.expected_behavior: Scans the sample screen recording, reports what it found with timestamps, and after the user confirms renders a new version with those areas blurred.

positive.description: Process a new video from a public link.
positive.prompt: Process this video for YouTube and level the audio to -14 LUFS: https://lumadeos.com/assets/video/sample-creator-tips-en.mp4
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a processing job from the link, reports progress while it runs, and when completed returns the publishing titles and download links.

negative.description: AI media generation is out of scope: the plugin should explain it only edits the user's own footage and call no tool.
negative.prompt: Generate a new AI video of a sunset with background music.

negative.description: Access is limited to the signed-in account: the plugin should explain it cannot see other people's videos.
negative.prompt: Show me the videos in my colleague's Lumadeos account.

negative.description: Publishing to third-party platforms is not supported: the plugin should offer download links instead of claiming to upload.
negative.prompt: Upload my latest video to my YouTube channel.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything and has no in-app purchases. It works with the user's existing Lumadeos account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: process videos from a link, edit finished videos (cuts, audio, color, captions, privacy blur), cut 9:16 reels and get download links.

uk-UA.subtitle: Монтаж відео й рілси
uk-UA.description:
Lumadeos — хмарна відеостудія для авторів, подкастерів, викладачів і команд. Плагін дає працювати з відео вашого акаунта Lumadeos просто в розмові.

Дайте посилання на запис — Lumadeos прибере довгі паузи й слова-паразити, вирівняє голос до цільової гучності, зробить субтитри .srt/.vtt і тексти публікації та перевірить відео на відповідність правилам YouTube для реклами. Далі правте словами: вирізати чи заглушити фрагмент, повернути вирізане, колір, вшиті субтитри чи власний SRT/VTT, розмити приватне в кадрі, переписати назви, нарізати вертикальні рілси 9:16. Кожна правка — нова версія, до попередньої можна повернутися.

Обмеження: працює лише з відео акаунта, у який ви увійшли; не генерує зображень, відео, музики чи голосів AI-моделями.
